business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates higher and vocational education, entertainment and livestreaming e-commerce businesses in mainland China, with most assets and operations in PRC consolidated affiliated entities under contractual arrangements.
business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition and boarding fees are generally received in advance and recognized over the relevant service period; livestreaming e-commerce includes promotion, commission and artist management income; TV/film product sales are recognized on delivery.
business_notes: CUCN had approximately 29,742 students as of 31 December 2024.
The group has no equity interest in the PRC consolidated affiliated entities but consolidates them through contractual arrangements.
CUCN conversion into a for-profit private school was still in process as of 31 December 2024.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow is consistently positive and above reported net profit because large impairment charges are non-cash and tuition is collected in advance. Free cash flow is positive in 2022 and 2024, but 2023 had heavy capex and profit is heavily affected by receivable impairments; VIE/school development fund restrictions lower distributable quality.

evidence.value: Revenue RMB771.378m, profit before tax RMB117.667m, current assets RMB1,437.019m in consolidated affiliated entities
evidence.note: Most operations/assets are in PRC VIE/consolidated affiliated entities.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash, time deposits and structured deposits by parent/listed offshore entity versus PRC operating/VIE/school entities.
No explicit restricted cash balance at 31 December 2024 was found, but the education business has contract liabilities and school development fund requirements.
Maintenance capex is estimated from recent actual capex because the report does not separately disclose maintenance versus growth capex.
